package shop

import (
	"context"
	"io"
	"log/slog"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bojanz/currency"

	"example.com/shop/internal/catalog"
	"example.com/shop/internal/platform/postgres/postgrestest"
)

// What a site shows when shown.go narrows it to the active products, as
// TestSSRShowsWhatTheProjectSays writes it beside the site: the inactive
// one is in no list, no sitemap, no llms.txt, and has no page.
func TestShowsWhatTheProjectSays(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	m := catalog.New(catalog.Deps{Pool: postgrestest.Fresh(t)})
	home, err := m.CreateCategory(ctx, catalog.NewCategory{Name: "Casa"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	price, err := currency.NewAmount("10", "BRL")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	plate, err := m.CreateProduct(ctx, catalog.NewProduct{Name: "Prato", Price: price, Code: "pr4to", Status: "ACTIVE", CategoryID: home.ID})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cup, err := m.CreateProduct(ctx, catalog.NewProduct{Name: "Copo", Price: price, Code: "c0po", Status: "INACTIVE", CategoryID: home.ID})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	srv := httptest.NewServer(New(Deps{Catalog: m, Logger: slog.New(slog.DiscardHandler)}))
	t.Cleanup(srv.Close)
	client := &http.Client{CheckRedirect: func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }}
	get := func(path string) (*http.Response, string) {
		t.Helper()
		res, err := client.Get(srv.URL + path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		defer res.Body.Close()
		body, _ := io.ReadAll(res.Body)
		return res, string(body)
	}

	for _, path := range []string{"/", "/produtos", "/produtos/casa", "/produtos?status=INACTIVE", "/sitemap.xml", "/llms.txt"} {
		res, body := get(path)
		if res.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("%s: %d", path, res.StatusCode)
		}
		if !strings.Contains(body, "Prato") && !strings.Contains(body, ProductPath(plate)) {
			t.Errorf("%s lacks the active product", path)
		}
		if strings.Contains(body, "Copo") || strings.Contains(body, ProductPath(cup)) {
			t.Errorf("%s shows the inactive product", path)
		}
	}
	if res, _ := get(ProductPath(plate)); res.StatusCode != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("the active product's page: %d", res.StatusCode)
	}
	for _, path := range []string{ProductPath(cup), "/produtos/" + cup.ID.String()} {
		if res, _ := get(path); res.StatusCode != http.StatusNotFound {
			t.Errorf("%s of the inactive product: %d, want 404", path, res.StatusCode)
		}
	}
}
